title: Checkout timeout retry for yemeksepeti
already_ships: Yemeksepeti retries failed payments once. Last year 1.5% of checkouts timed out with about €3.2M attributed loss on the checkout journey.

options.title: Keep one retry
options.summary: Leave the single payment retry and current timeout window unchanged this quarter.

options.title: Second retry + hold
options.summary: Add a second retry after 30 seconds and hold the basket so the customer does not re-order.

devils_advocate.why_fails: A second retry can double-charge and create a claims spike that eats the saved checkout GMV.
devils_advocate.who_loses: Customers billed twice and the claims team that has to unwind those payments.
devils_advocate.cannot_measure: Net GMV after chargebacks will not be clean in ninety days of one brand.
devils_advocate.why_not_live_control: The existing single retry already recovers the obvious drop-offs without a double-charge risk.

recommendation.argument: The locked outcome is a Finance-grade cut in timeout loss; a measured second retry is the only option that can prove it.
